notes: Both לָכֶם phrases are recast as bare English objects, so each לְ is unrepresented under rule 40 while its suffix carries *you*.
*wherewith* goes to אֲשֶׁר alone: no resumptive preposition-plus-suffix stands in the clause, so rule 22's three-morpheme fusion does not apply here.
בְּיוֹם הַמַּגֵּפָה is rule 29's arthrous case — the article takes the *the* before its own word and the construct takes the supplied one.
